question: Which victorious goddess is invoked to protect the speaker from all sides?
premises: The goddess is identified as Nitya, called Nilapataka, and Vijaya.
Protection is requested from all sides.
The speaker is the object of protection.
inference: The victorious goddess Nitya Nilapataka Vijaya is invoked to protect the speaker from every direction.
uncertainties: Whether these are one goddess with multiple epithets or closely associated forms is interpretive.
plain_english: May the eternal goddess called Nilapataka, the victorious one, protect me from all sides.
